To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) we introduce a novel rumour detection approach that learns from the reporting dynamics of breaking news in social networks; 2) the classifier we propose achieves competitive performance compared to the state of the-art rumour detection classifier; and 3) our classifier does not rely on querying tweets for rumour detection but rather detects rumours from the tweet content alone.
